properties.text: She goes first. Follow her: you are partners, and every part of the way is one you finish together
A door opens while someone stands on a plate. She holds the left plate for you. Or run the right one
Pale slabs give way and stay gone. If she breaks the way, go round by the stones on the left
A slot in the right wall is too narrow for you. She is small enough: watch what she does with it
Or go it alone: climb the ledges up and over the wall. Harder, and you still finish together
A searchlight sweeps the hall and sends you back to cover if it sees you. Pillars are shadow
She will draw the light to herself from the open spot on the right. Cross while it is on her
A place to rest. The city is behind you
Stand on this plate to hold the door open while she comes through
